chunks: He said: And I asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام.

About a free woman who married a slave on the basis that he was free, then later came to know that he was owned. He عليه السلام said: "She has greater authority over herself. If she wishes, after learning, she may affirm him and remain with him; and if she wishes, she may not remain. If the slave had consummated with her, then she is entitled to the dowry for what he made lawful of her private part. And if he had not consummated with her, then the marriage is invalid. But if she remains with him after learning that he is an owned slave, then he has the stronger claim over her."

key_terms.أَمْلَكُ بِنَفْسِهَا: having authority and choice over herself in this matter
key_terms.الصَّدَاقُ: the dowry owed to the wife
key_terms.حُرَّةٍ: a free woman, not in bondage
key_terms.فَرْجِهَا: her private part, meaning conjugal access

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a free woman marries a man thinking he is free and later discovers he is a slave?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a free woman who marries a man believing him to be free, only to later discover that he is a slave. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام explains that after learning the truth she may either remain or separate, and clarifies the ruling of dowry and the validity of the marriage depending on whether consummation occurred.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
I asked Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) about a free woman who married a man thinking he was free, but later discovered that he was a slave.
Imam (as) said: "She has authority over herself. After learning the truth, if she wishes, she may stay with him and accept him, or if she wishes, she may leave him.
If the slave had consummated the marriage with her, then she is entitled to the dowry for what was made lawful to him from her. However, if he had not consummated the marriage, then the marriage is invalid.
But if she chooses to remain with him after learning that he is a slave, then he has the right to keep her as his wife."
